description: CloudFormation S3 bucket with no encryption, versioning, logging or public-access block
note: CIS AWS 2.1.1. The bare bucket, in the language's own syntax -- the same resource the Terraform cases open with, reached through CloudFormation rule ids. Labelled 2026-09-23 against the pinned Trivy 0.74.0, checkov 3.3.16 and KICS 2.1.20. checkov is deliberately absent from the labels and that is the finding, not an omission: it raises CKV_AWS_18/21/53/54/55/56 on this file -- logging, versioning and the four public-access-block checks -- and no encryption check at all, where both other tools have one. The same gap the Bicep and ARM cases document per tool. The public-access and versioning rules the other two raise are real and unlabelled here because cfn-json-syntax and the clean control cover that ground.
